_about: Jack Coffey Field (decisions/0023, redrawn in 0029): Fordham's FieldTurf football and soccer field, with Moglia Stadium along its north side. Houlihan Park's baseball diamond is laid on the same turf at its south end; the two landmarks are drawn as one picture split between them. A landmark: the sign on its west edge opens its card.
name: Jack Coffey Field
